'''Rajivari's holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] created by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Rajivari]], one of the founding members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at some point before his death on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in [[25,783 BBY]]. The holocron contained the information about the [[Fount of Rajivari]] and remained on Tython for millennia until [[3643 BBY]], when it was discovered by [[Nalen Raloch]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] colonist. Raloch learned from the holocron and eventually fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]], deciding to destroy the Jedi Order. However, a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi]] stopped Raloch and recovered the Rajivari's holocron, delivering it to the Jedi Council.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rajivari's holocron appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Consular class mission on Tython.
